name: failed-payment-rescuer
description: Finds failed payments in your own payments account over the last 7 days (1 to 30 if you ask, or since your last run in this conversation): failed charges and invoices whose latest attempt failed. For each it reads the customer's plan and payment history, classifies the decline reason and how recoverable it is, flags high-value customers, and ranks them by recoverability, value and how soon retries run out. On request it drafts a personalised recovery email per failure and a chat digest of the high-value ones, and sends each only after you approve that exact text, one at a time. Every customer, amount and code is checked against the tool output. It never retries a charge, changes a subscription or offers a discount. On demand only: there is no automatic trigger.
